messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Getting Error in genind2hierfstat(snps) alleles must be encoded as integers or nucleotides. Exiting
parts:
Hello,

This code worked for me. I would suggest using it.

library('adegenet')
library('hierfstat')
x <- read.csv("https://groups.google.com/group/poppr/attach/77fd29f6cc04c/example.csv?part=0.2&authuser=0", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
gid <- df2genind(x[-(1:2)], NA.char = "MISSING", sep = "/", ind.names = x[[1]], pop = x[[2]])
table(unlist(alleles(gid)))
#>
#>  A  C  G  T
#> 65 19 52  7
genind2hierfstat(gid)[1:10, 1:10]
#>     pop M1 M2 M3 M4 M5 M6 M7 M8 M9
#> 1  pop1 33 11 11 33 11 33 33 11 33
#> 2  pop1 33 11 11 33 11 11 33 11 33
